contracts.registration: Explicit Rust registration, separately named files; configured toggle/kind targets, existing typed set/remove input, clear identity breditor/clear-flat-list-inline-formats
contracts.inline: Shared pure format policy over real flat-list paths; mixed toggles add everywhere; typed set replaces a complete format property map while preserving peers; clear/remove do not alter text, block kind, list layout or starts
contracts.toolbar: Tracked activation and typed uniform/mixed/unset values; invalid requested properties disable with inactive activation but preserve the observed value; clear is stateless
contracts.collapsed: Pending override then focus-affinity context; pending-only edit with no document undo entry, including empty items and zero operation budget; subsequent typing consumes override and undo restores it
contracts.blockKind: Paragraph and heading ranks 1-6 within bare/list blocks; exclude a later endpoint at logical start, include empty collapsed blocks; preserve exact selection encoding and pending formats
contracts.history: Extended formatting is one atomic record; logical positions, direction and affinities survive run changes; undo restores exact original selections/runs/properties/layout and redo restores the result
contracts.admission: Complete-result validation including unguarded roots; no transient per-item state; node, property, merged-leaf and operation limits disable; stale and disabled preparations preserve state and redo
contracts.wire: Existing default/heading-only registrations and operation/session encodings remain closed; no rebuilt shipping Wasm or browser list claim
